item_name: Rothco Vintage Canvas & Leather Travel Shoulder Bag
item_short_desc: Our Vintage Canvas & Leather Travel Shoulder Bag offers an all-in-one place to organize and carry your traveling essentials. This compact shoulder bag keeps your possessions close to you through a crossbody design, and is great for travel, work, everyday use, and more.
description: Our Vintage Canvas & Leather Travel Shoulder Bag offers an all-in-one place to organize and carry your traveling essentials. This compact shoulder bag keeps your possessions close to you through a crossbody design, and is great for travel, work, everyday use, and more. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. These crossbody travel bags are made of 100% cotton canvas that’s reinforced with double-stitched seams, ensuring that your gear stays protected as you travel. These canvas bags also feature genuine buffalo leather accents for a vintage look and feel. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of premium canvas bags and packs. Spacious Zipper Compartments: These canvas travel bags measure 8.25 inch x 6 inch x 7 inch, and are designed with 4 zipper comprtments: a large main storage compartment for carrying bulkier items like a camera or a water bottle, a rear compartment for holding a map or paper documents, and 2 front pockets for securing small essentials. Utility Pockets: The front flap features a magnetic button closure for convenient and easy access to the zipper pocket underneath, while also featuring an open-top pocket that’s secured by a cinch strap, ensuring your items are safe and secure. The 2 side pockets offer additional storage for smaller accessories, utilizing an elastic closer and drain hole on one side, and a magnetic button closure on the other. Various Carrying Options: These heavy-duty canvas bags come equipped with an adjustable shoulder strap that extends up to 58 inches, giving you the option to wear as a crossbody bag, or either around your neck or shoulder. The strap can be removed by detaching the 2 metal side clips, allowing you to easily store it in your car or larger bag. The top grab handle offers quick and easy handling while the back belt loop provides additional mobility.
